scope: fixed source semantic audit only; original CPP not built or published

rules.trials: trial=0..4; fifth unresolved pass still moves coordinates, no sixth calculation
rules.normal_success: active incidence count==0 or normalized sum length>0
rules.pending_order: initial vertices ascending, next pending sorted
rules.neighbor_updates: failed vertex and ordered one-ring move sequentially; moved successful neighbors not reevaluated
rules.plane_cut: only failed vertex x/y moves; z/neighbors/face cache stay unchanged
rules.face_cache: initial ripped face marks all vertices border; active nonfullyripped face stores raw area cross; after3D jitter only failed-vertex incident active faces recomputed
rules.original_area: assigned only when stored origarea<0; successful area divide3 fix=true else2
rules.FNV: three uint32 trial/vertex/counter; little endian bytes, FNV1a lower32 bits, fixed ±0.001mm float32; counter resets perfailedvertex and continues into neighboraxis updates
rules.unresolved: source finishes after five rounds even if pending remains; return explicit unresolvedlist, no approximate repair
rules.shared_geometry: return coordinates and stale-by-source successful normals; caller must invalidate coordinate metrics and cannot replace only normal output
